Golden Mobile Grooming came highly recommended, and they did not disappoint.

Poppy looks amazing! He did an exceptional job, especially considering she’s had some pretty bad experiences with other groomers and can be difficult when she’s nervous. He was patient with her and did a great job working with her.

Very happy with how she turned out. 10/10, highly recommend! We’ll definitely be using Golden Mobile Grooming again.

Nicolas is always communicative, listens to our needs and is just truly talented with dog haircuts.  Mango can be a bit of a spaz but he seems to enjoy his time with Nicolas so we couldn’t be happier.
